design.what: the manual and the mood grew with every version after v3.42 — 93 pages and 31 causes in v3.49
the chief's return is a scene: the new man walks in from the ring's edge (the camp still short while he walks), takes the rag down, and the pole stands bare beside the fire a day
the muster roll is Crew (the plain names)
a pulled bolt leaves a scar (the check sees it after the medic's pull and the town's)
